message: How to try corpus → training-only BPE → tiny model trained from the same initial weights → compare the same prompt's saved continuations. Memorization/mechanics practice, not knowledge or quality.

limits: Only the original tiny local Transformer generated the continuations; this film explains stored results and is not a live UI or session recording.
The loop ring, gear rotation, travelling pieces and unrolling strips are concept motion. They are not probabilities, attention maps, weight trajectories, per-token decoding or a training-batch trace.
Blank pieces on the training stream carry no numbers, so the four P01 prompt IDs are never shown as a training minibatch.
Checkpoint dots are only the five saved anchors 0/200/400/600/800; their lighting times are evenly spaced for viewing, not measured times.
Validation loss 6.1135 → 0.1900 is a 200-batch estimate on a validation side whose 13 lines all appear in training; it is shown once as a secondary caption, never as a stat card.

Excerpts are literal characters from the start of each saved continuation, stopped at the first line break and marked 抜粋 with an ellipsis. Full strings and IDs are in the page folds and the saved JSON.
P08 shows no answer, no answer bubble and no capital name; the saved 800-update output continues story words.

scenes.what: The whole network appears group by group from a ghost at 0 s; one pulse runs the training side (3.3–4.1 s) then both prompt branches to the JSON (4.1–4.9 s).

Line slips leave the book for 83/13 (5.1–6.9 s); the 13 duplicate links redraw (6.7–7.9 s) with the twin rows lit; training lines enter the BPE and leave as blank pieces (7.9–9.9 s); the dotted 同じBPE link and P01's four IDs return (9.0–9.9 s).

Blank pieces stream into the loop; only the 800-update machine's gear and ring move; its five saved anchors relight; the 0-update machine stays still. Caption: 200-batch validation loss with the duplicate caveat.
The same four IDs travel to both machines; each emits its first saved new ID (301 / 409); both output strips unroll their literal excerpts.

The P08 question strip replaces P01; its 17 IDs travel to both; the 0-update strip shows question marks and the 800-update strip shows ' is blue. A friend brings a red book.' — story words, no answer.
P01 returns; both continuations flow into the JSON sheet; from 29.5 s the frame is settled. Poster at 31 s.
